    StartersQuarry day Italian sub rollsLong soft rolls dressed with oregano vinaigrette and layered Italian styleHow to make it4 long soft rolls3 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp red wine vinegar1 tsp dried oregano12 slices of provolone16 slices of salami12 slices of leg ham1/4 iceberg lettuce, shredded2 tomatoes, sliced1 red onion, sliced4 tbsp pickled pepperssalt and pepper, to tasteWhisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.Split the rolls and drizzle the insides with half the dressing.Layer with provolone, salami and ham.Top with lettuce, tomato, red onion and pickled peppers, drizzle with the rest of the dressing and close.Wrap each tightly in baking paper and halve.Red balloon roast tomato ricotta toastWhipped ricotta and roast tomatoes on sourdough, red as the balloonHow to make it500g cherry tomatoes on the vine2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil4 sprigs of thyme250g ricotta, whipped1 sourdough loaf, sliced and toastedRoast the tomatoes at 200°C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme.Toast the sourdough.Spread whipped ricotta over the toast and top with the tomatoes.
